const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import re,difflib
s=open('input.md').read()
for part in re.split(r'^## (?=sample-\d+)',s,flags=re.M)[1:]:
    sid=part.splitlines()[0]
    am=re.search(r'### Delivered Text Artifact\s*\n```text\n(.*?)\n```',part,re.S)
    print(sid)
    if not am:
        print('NO ARTIFACT')
        continue
    a=am.group(1)
    h=re.search(r'^# (.+)$',a,re.M).group(1)
    aft=a[a.index('# '+h)+len(h)+2:].strip()
    stand=aft.split('\n\n')[0].strip('*')
    heads=re.findall(r'^## (.+)$',a,re.M)
    print('headline_chars=',len(h),'standfirst_words=',len(stand.split()),'subheading_chars=',[len(x) for x in heads])
    before=aft.split('\n## ',1)[0]
    paragraphs=before.split('\n\n')
    print('prefirst_heading_paragraphs=',[(len(p.split()),p[:70]) for p in paragraphs])
    im=re.search(r'### Complete supplied input\s*\n```text\n(.*?)\n```',part,re.S)
    if im:
        original=im.group(1)
        print('exact_identical=',original==a)
        for line in difflib.unified_diff(original.splitlines(),a.splitlines(),n=0):
            if not line.startswith(('---','+++','@@')):
                print(line)
    print()
PY","max_output_tokens":10500});text(r.output);
